title: Automation Level
description: Catalog entry describing how an area, building or equipment class is operated, and what that implies for movement rules. Replaces a closed enum that was duplicated across three schemas with the behavioural consequences hardcoded as conditionals - see Warehouse-as-Code ADR-0001, measure 3.

automated.description: Whether automation is present at this level at all. A storage_type may only declare a controller when its automation_level is automated - tools/validate.py enforces this.

movement_policy.description: The movement_policy a storage_type at this level must use, if it states one. Omit for a level that carries no such consequence. This enum stays closed on purpose: it is grammar (how rules are read), not vocabulary.

requires_movement_policy.description: When true, a storage_type at this level must state movement_policy rather than leaving it out. Only meaningful together with movement_policy.
